svg.text: Ch 1 · Scale From Zero to Millions of Users
The fully scaled web architecture, built up piece by piece

g.text: DNS turns the domain name into the load balancer's IP
Static files (images, JS, CSS) come from a nearby CDN
Dynamic requests go via the load balancer to any web server
Web servers are stateless: session data lives in a shared store
Read the cache first; on a miss, read the database
Writes go to the master, which replicates to slaves
Slow jobs are queued and processed by workers asynchronously
